Envelope.description: How a request should travel. `payload` is a SignInMagicLinkRequest serialised to a string, and it is signed as that exact string — never re-serialised, so the signature does not depend on JSON key order agreeing between the two ends. OWN_SECRET is the signing key and never leaves either end.

timestamp.description: Unix seconds. Inside the signature, so it cannot be adjusted.

email.description: Recipient address; must be on the vednemesicnik.cz domain.

link.description: The sign-in verify URL. Must be an https link on the configured origin whose path is the verify route (/administration/sign-in/magic-link/verify).

mailError.description: Present only when error is "mail_send_failed": the underlying reason the delegated send failed.

description: Contract for the Vedneměsíčník administration magic-link web app. POST a SignInMagicLinkRequest to send a sign-in link; the response is a SignInMagicLinkResponse. The send is delegated to the mail service, whose reason is surfaced in mailError when error is "mail_send_failed".
title: MagicLink
